propositions: CLI parser definitions must be side-effect-free stdlib argparse factories used identically by runtime execution and build-time generation with no manual help authority or docs-only grammars.

The lazy route registry provides single canonical identity, spellings, visibility, handler/parser references, mount policy, confirmation/output policy, and semantic capabilities for every visible command.

Pre-operation help paths (overview and canonical command help) must be byte-current generated package data derived from committed parser artifacts, readable before config materialization or handler resolution.

All command spellings (exact, compatibility, hidden, retired) including historical jira-onboard and unknown purge-bridge must exhibit approved behavior without dual routing or intercept-ladder reconstruction.

Optional mode/backend capabilities must declare postures (error, unavailable, abstain, fallback) after the selected backend is known, with no eager optional imports during help or unknown-command output.
CLI reference generation, coverage verification, and wheel quality checks must enumerate registry and parser artifacts rather than source regexes or manual command census.
